thought.text: Die Methoden fehlen! Lass mich sie hinzufügen:

reasoning_content:
The VPS ChunkSystem has `getChunk` but NOT `getActiveChunks` or `setChunkActive`. These methods are missing - that's the API mismatch.

Let me add these missing methods to the VPS ChunkSystem to make it work.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Add getActiveChunks and setChunkActive methods to ChunkSystem
# First see how the file ends
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("End:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
